lines.trans: Now you are in deep trouble, lad.
Chef, believe me, it just happened accidentally.
You had to think with your head in advance.
What am I to do now?
Their family will not leave you alone now.
Do you know this family so well?
I myself used to live in this family.
And did they drive you out of the house?
They took all strength from me.
Maybe I should just leave for Voronezh?
You will not go anywhere now.
But I am very afraid of such responsibility.
A man is obliged to answer for his actions.

examples.trans: We have nobody to fear here.

examples.text: Это наш город. Нам здесь бояться некого.
examples.trans: This is our town. We have nobody to fear here.

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I grew up in a communal flat.
Hello! How was it in Hungary?
All right, here you go. There, look.

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

выгнать.gloss: to kick out, to evict, to drive out

meanings.en: to kick out, to drive out

examples.text: Для тебя она добрая. А меня она выгонит!
examples.trans: She's kind to you. But she'll kick me out!

examples.text: Значит, меня не выгонят со службы?
examples.trans: Does that mean I won't be fired from service?

meanings.note: an idiom for a big telling-off

meanings.en: 'голову оторвать' = to tear someone's head off
meanings.note: an idiom for a big telling-off

examples.trans: Mum will tear my head off.

examples.text: Какая тебе опергруппа? Мне твоя мать голову оторвёт.
examples.trans: What field team? Your mother will tear my head off.

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to do, to make', paired with 'сделать'.

examples.trans: Hi, Arkady Borisovich. What are you doing?
There's a new building on Simashko Street.

examples.text: Квартира будет отличная. На Симашко есть новый дом.
examples.trans: It'll be an excellent flat. There's a new building on Simashko Street.

meanings.note: думать о + prepositional = to think about

examples.trans: I have no time to think about that.

examples.text: Мне некогда об этом думать. Слишком много дел.
examples.trans: I have no time to think about that. There's too much to do.

meanings.note: adds emphasis to the word before it

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to live'.

examples.trans: I live in a communal flat.

examples.text: Я хочу нормально жить! Я хочу биде, понимаешь?
examples.trans: I want to live like a normal person! I want a bidet, do you understand?

забрать.gloss: to take back, to take away

meanings.en: to take away, to pick up
meanings.note: забрать заявление = to withdraw a statement
забрать заявление = to withdraw a statement

examples.text: Поговори с Аракеляном. Пусть он заберёт заявление.
examples.trans: Talk to Arakelyan. Get him to withdraw his statement.

meanings.en: in advance, beforehand, ahead of time

examples.trans: Did you set all this up in advance?

examples.text: Мы купили билеты на поезд заранее.
examples.trans: We bought the train tickets in advance.

examples.text: Тогда заранее желаю вам приятного аппетита!
examples.trans: Then in advance I wish you bon appétit!

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: + genitive: 'из мэрии' = from the town hall

examples.text: Марина Сергеевна, я уже знаю. Мне звонили из мэрии.
examples.trans: Marina Sergeyevna, I already know. The town hall called me.

examples.text: Этого не может быть. Это наша история.
examples.trans: That can't be. It's our history.

meanings.note: adult male; declines like a feminine -а noun

examples.text: У мужчины бывает не только жена.
examples.trans: A man can have more than just a wife.
This man is waiting for you.

examples.text: У мужчины, мальчик, бывает не только жена. Это моя девушка.
examples.trans: A man, my boy, can have more than just a wife. She's my girlfriend.

meanings.en: must, need to, it is necessary

examples.trans: We need to do even more.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

meanings.en: nowhere, not anywhere (direction/destination, used with не or нет)

examples.text: Слушайте, да не нужно вам никуда ехать.
examples.trans: Listen, you don't need to go anywhere.

examples.text: Да никуда я не пряталась! Я контролировала ситуацию.
examples.trans: I wasn't hiding anywhere! I was controlling the situation.

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо ещё.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need more.
I want to, but I can't.

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо сделать ещё больше.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need to do even more.

meanings.note: usually in short form обязан/обязана + dative + instrumental

examples.trans: You are obliged to come on time.

examples.text: Ты выпустишь меня под подписку о невыезде. И ты мне больше ничем не обязан.
examples.trans: You'll release me on a travel ban. And you won't owe me anything anymore.

meanings.note: Core Russian pron meaning 'they' in everyday speech.

examples.text: Ты преподавай. А они пусть строят свои торговые центры.
examples.trans: You teach. And let them build their shopping centres.

examples.text: Меня уже тошнит от этой коммуналки! У нас труба уже неделю течёт.
examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat! Our pipe has been leaking for a week now.

meanings.note: под мою ответственность = on my responsibility

examples.text: Хорошо, давайте три. Под мою личную ответственность.
examples.trans: All right, let's say three. On my personal responsibility.

meanings.en: to answer, to reply, to pick up the phone

examples.text: Я вам звоню, а вы не отвечаете!
examples.trans: I call you, and you don't answer!

examples.text: Почему ты не отвечаешь на мои вопросы?
examples.trans: Why aren't you answering my questions?

отстать.gloss: to fall behind, to leave alone

examples.trans: He was left behind by the train.

examples.text: Пожалуйста, немедленно отстань от нашей семьи!
examples.trans: Please, immediately leave our family alone!
I love our town very much.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.note: + dative of the person: поверить ему

examples.text: Со своего телефона? И все поверили?
examples.trans: From your own phone? And everyone believed it?

поехать.gloss: to go (by vehicle), to set off

meanings.en: to go, to set off (by car, bus, train)

examples.trans: All right, Arkashenka. We'll be off, it's time.

получиться.gloss: to turn out, to work out

meanings.en: to turn out, to work out
meanings.note: всё получилось = it all worked out

meanings.en: to come out of, to make
meanings.note: из тебя получится мэр = you'll make a mayor

examples.text: Классный из тебя мэр получится, Самсон.
examples.trans: You'll make a great mayor, Samson.

meanings.en: to get to, to end up
meanings.note: как попасть в центр? = how do I get to the centre?

examples.trans: A firework hit the power station.
How do I get to the station?

examples.text: Скажи: салют попал в станцию. Три района без света.
examples.trans: Say a firework hit the power station. Three districts without electricity.
I committed a very foolish act.

examples.text: Это был благородный и смелый поступок.
examples.trans: It was a noble and brave deed.

examples.text: Соколов, не делай сейчас таких глупых поступков.
examples.trans: Sokolov, do not do such foolish deeds right now.

examples.text: Мы просто не хотели вас беспокоить. Всё отменим!
examples.trans: We just didn't want to bother you. We'll cancel it all!

examples.text: В моей комнате раньше дядя Миша жил.
examples.trans: Uncle Misha used to live in my room.
There used to be an old park here.

examples.text: Подождите. В моей комнате раньше дядя Миша жил.
examples.trans: Wait. Uncle Misha used to live in my room.

examples.text: Я и сама хорошо проведу время.
examples.trans: I'll have a good time on my own.

meanings.note: refers back to the subject: 'он держит своё слово' = he keeps his word

examples.text: А что я за мэр такой, который держит своё слово?
examples.trans: And what kind of mayor would I be if I kept my word?

examples.text: Конечно, помогу. Кто у вас сейчас начальник?
examples.trans: Of course I'll help. Who's your boss now?

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'емья'). Common feminine noun meaning 'family' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Так, семья Самсоновых. Он строитель, она медсестра.
examples.trans: Right, the Samsonov family. He's a builder, she's a nurse.
How much power does this car have?

examples.text: Да, по-моему, здорово! Сколько сил в этой машине?
examples.trans: Yes, I think it's great! How much power does this car have?
The wind is blowing hard outside.

examples.text: Я так два года потеряла. Любила так сильно!
examples.trans: I lost two years like that. I loved him so much!

meanings.note: а вы случайно не...? = are you by any chance...?

examples.trans: Are you by any chance Samson?

examples.text: Здравствуйте! Извините, а вы случайно не Самсон?
examples.trans: Hello! Excuse me, are you by any chance Samson?

meanings.note: at the start of a question

examples.trans: So I shouldn't wait for you?
So I shouldn't wait for you tonight?

meanings.note: 'что я за мэр такой' = what kind of mayor am I

examples.text: Теперь я начальник нашей стройки. Ты уволен!
examples.trans: Now I'm the boss of our building site. You're fired!

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

уехать.gloss: to leave, to go away (by vehicle)

examples.trans: I'll be gone for an hour.

examples.text: Слушай, я уеду на полтора часа. Ты с Викой посиди, понял?
examples.trans: Listen, I'm going out for an hour and a half. You stay with Vika, got it?

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

meanings.note: pointing at a thing or a situation; 'это' + noun = 'this is ...'
points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

examples.trans: And this is for you. A toy car!

meanings.note: alone: 'я этого не хочу' = I don't want that

examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat.

examples.text: Меня уже тошнит от этой коммуналки! У нас труба уже неделю течёт.
examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat! Our pipe has been leaking for a week now.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
